facts.fact: The Federal Ministry of Education's reviewed EMIS policy, approved by the National Council on Education in August 2021, recommends as basic infrastructure for each Local Government Education Authority data node internet connectivity with a V-Sat facility, a mini server, at least six computers and 24-hour UPS power; it gives no cost, leaves each node to cost its own needs, and states no node as connected.
facts.system: LGEA EMIS node: internet connectivity with V-Sat facility

systems.platform: NEMIS software; electronic Annual School Census template
systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Education, Statistics and NEMIS
systems.tiers: Apex national database; data flows from school to LGA to State to Federal; over 900 data nodes named
LGEA, as a data node storing reports from the schools in its LGA, preferably in electronic format

note: A sector policy: the one fact is a recommendation, not a costed plan, and concerns the Local Government Education Authority rather than the council secretariat; the parent decides whether it counts. The policy also says equipment and EMIS infrastructure are inadequate, naming the Federal and State levels only.
